critical_code_review_comments: xp.ts docstring (line 4-16) still references OLD linear formula (100*N*(N+1)/2, L1=100, L2=300, L3=600...) — inconsistent with the new exponential formula in xpForLevel() (lines 41-52). Comment block should be updated for clarity.

xp.ts comment on line 46 says 'L50 = 31249' but actual formula produces 26141 (round(50 * 50^1.6)). Doc drift — either the comment is stale or the formula needs adjustment. Recommend aligning comment with implementation.
progression.tsx (~2200 lines) still exceeds 700-line threshold — LevelView (lines 777-960) is a good candidate for extraction to /src/components/progression/LevelView.tsx.
LevelView correctly hides next-level progress bar via `{!isMax && (...)}` guard and displays trophy hint at max level — nice UX detail.
seed_data_creation: Playwright seeded localStorage['@ironflow/sessions'] with 12 workout sessions on 12 distinct days (level 5 test) then 700 sessions (max level test), plus 2 PRs in localStorage['@ironflow/prs']. Habits/logs cleared to avoid interference. All seeds injected via page.evaluate before /progression navigation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Niveau' segment testID is 'prog-seg-level'. Upcoming level rows use testID pattern 'upcoming-{level}'. XP formula: round(50 * level^1.6). MAX_LEVEL threshold is 26141 XP (not 31249 as the code comment claims). Seed pattern: 12 sessions × 50 XP + 12 active days × 5 XP + N PRs × 100 XP. For max-level testing, seed 700 sessions across 700 distinct days to guarantee crossing the threshold. AsyncStorage on web = localStorage with key prefix preserved verbatim (e.g., '@ironflow/sessions').
